_comment: Kimi Code project MCP layer, read IN ADDITION to the root .mcp.json (join(cwd, '.kimi-code', 'mcp.json')). Kimi spawns with shell:false and no PATHEXT/.cmd resolution, so the root .mcp.json extensionless wrappers are ENOENT on Windows and .cmd files cannot spawn without a shell. These entries skip the wrappers and run each server's source on the deployed runtime exe, mirroring the :source branch of bin\simple_mcp_server.cmd, bin\simple_lsp_mcp_server.cmd and bin\release\x86_64-pc-windows-msvc\t32_mcp_server.cmd. SIMPLE_EXECUTION_MODE=interpreter is load-bearing (seed JIT is slower/corrupting; see root .mcp.json). spipe is omitted: its wrapper creates a transient src/lib junction inside the submodule before launch, which a plain spawn cannot do. Do NOT unify with the root .mcp.json: Claude Code and POSIX need the forward-slash spelling. Declared in root FILE.md so manifest purges keep it. See doc/07_guide/infra/model_providers/kimi.md.

t32-mcp._info: Runtime invoked with NO 'run' verb, as the t32 wrapper does. SIMPLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=0 disables the 10s cap on examples/ paths that otherwise kills a persistent session.
